lines.rookie: On the morning of 29 April 1932, Yun Bong-gil and Kim Gu ate breakfast, then swapped watches. Yun said he would need a watch for only one more hour. So he left his new watch with Kim Gu. Haesu wrote the true record for the Provisional Government, and Kim Gu signed it. That day Yun acted at Hongkou Park and was caught. After it, Chinese leaders helped the Provisional Government strongly.
lines.junior: On the morning of 29 April 1932, Yun Bong-gil and Kim Gu had breakfast and then exchanged watches. Yun said he would need a watch for only one more hour, so he left his new watch with Kim Gu. Haesu wrote a true record for the Provisional Government, and Kim Gu signed it. That day Yun acted at Hongkou Park and was caught. After that, Chinese leaders helped the Provisional Government strongly.
lines.master: On the morning of 29 April 1932, Yun Bong-gil and Kim Gu shared breakfast and then exchanged watches. Saying he would need a watch for only one more hour, Yun left his new watch with Kim Gu. Haesu wrote a true record for the Provisional Government, which Kim Gu signed. That same day Yun acted at Hongkou Park and was caught at once. From then on, Chinese leaders helped the Provisional Government strongly.

Yun held his new watch up.
He pointed at its long hand.

Yun raised his new watch.
He pointed to its long hand.
"Once this hand has gone round one more time, I shall have no need of a watch."
"My watch is new and yours is old, so let us exchange them."
"I will need a watch for only one more ____."
"You, though, will need one for a long, long time."
With that, he took my old watch and pressed his into my hand.

lines.junior: People need to know what really happened today.
lines.master: People must know the truth of what happened today.

lines.rookie: Haesu asks: "Line one: they swapped after breakfast. Who saw it happen?"
lines.junior: Haesu asks: "Line one says they swapped after breakfast. Who saw it happen?"
lines.master: Haesu asks: "Line one claims they swapped after breakfast. Who saw it happen?"

lines.rookie: Your own note: breakfast first, then the swap.
lines.junior: Your own note from this morning: first breakfast, then the swap.
lines.master: Your own note: breakfast came first, and the swap followed.

lines.rookie: Yes. I saw it with my own eyes.
lines.junior: That's right. I saw it with my own eyes.
lines.master: Yes. I witnessed it with my own eyes.

lines.rookie: That does not show who saw the swap.
lines.junior: That doesn't show who saw the swap.
lines.master: That says nothing of who witnessed the swap.

lines.rookie: Read the note you put in order this morning.
lines.junior: Read again the note you put in order this morning.
lines.master: Look again at the note you set in order this morning.

lines.rookie: Haesu asks: "Line two: Mr. Kim holds Mr. Yun's watch. Show me that watch."
lines.junior: Haesu asks: "Line two says Mr. Kim is holding Mr. Yun's watch. Can you show me that watch?"
lines.master: Haesu asks: "Line two claims Mr. Kim holds Mr. Yun's watch. Can you produce that very watch?"

lines.rookie: The smooth new watch, with no scratches.
lines.junior: This one: the smooth new watch with no scratches.
lines.master: The smooth new watch, without a single scratch.

lines.rookie: And Mr. Kim keeps it in his pocket now.
lines.junior: And now Mr. Kim keeps it in his pocket.
lines.master: And Mr. Kim now keeps it in his pocket.

lines.rookie: That is not a watch.
lines.junior: That isn't a watch.
lines.master: That is no watch.

lines.rookie: Find the watch with no scratches.
lines.junior: Look for the watch with no scratches.
lines.master: Seek out the watch that bears no scratches.

lines.rookie: Haesu asks: "Line three: why did Mr. Yun give his new watch away?"
lines.junior: Haesu asks: "Line three: why did Mr. Yun give away his new watch?"
lines.master: Haesu asks: "Line three: why would Mr. Yun part with his new watch?"

lines.rookie: He needed a watch for only one more hour.
lines.junior: He said he needed a watch for only one more hour.
lines.master: By his own words, he needed a watch for only one more hour.

lines.rookie: Then that is the truest line of all.
lines.junior: Then that is the truest line of all.
lines.master: Then that is the truest line of all.

lines.rookie: That does not say why.
lines.junior: That doesn't say why.
lines.master: That does not tell us why.

lines.rookie: Read what Mr. Kim told you Yun said.
lines.junior: Read again what Mr. Kim told you Yun said.
lines.master: Look again at the words Mr. Kim repeated to you.

lines.rookie: SIGN THE RECORD
lines.junior: SIGN THE RECORD
lines.master: SIGN THE RECORD

lines.rookie: On 29 April 1932, Yun Bong-gil acted at a Japanese army event in Hongkou Park.
lines.junior: On 29 April 1932, Yun Bong-gil took action at a Japanese army event in Hongkou Park.
lines.master: On 29 April 1932, at a Japanese army event in Hongkou Park, Yun Bong-gil acted.

lines.rookie: He was caught at once.
lines.junior: He was caught there at once.
lines.master: He was seized on the spot.

lines.rookie: One day, children in Korea will read this.
lines.junior: Some day, children in Korea will read this.
lines.master: One day, the children of Korea will read this.
